note: Cook Islanders hold New Zealand citizenship, as New Zealand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade says; New Zealand issues no national identity card, so they hold none.

sources.title: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Cook Islands
sources.said: Cook Islanders hold New Zealand citizenship

sources.title: Department of Internal Affairs, OIA 2526-1378, Appendix A (as published by the Free Speech Union)
sources.said: New Zealand does not have, and is not planning to create, a single national ID, digital ID or unique
